desc: 长毛绒面与光面皮革撞质拼接，开襟短款坎肩廓形，涂鸦墙杂志封面街拍体系
leaf: 短款长毛皮草皮革拼接坎肩外套
name: 涂鸦街拍撞质质感坎肩外套款

shots.intent: 用杂志封面式的人像气场在详情页第一屏换取停留与下滑。
shots.textZone: oversized serif masthead across the top reading 「{callout_1}」; one short label at upper right reading 「{selling_point_1}」

shots.intent: 一秒讲清核心主张：同一件外套上两种相反质面的撞质拼接。
shots.textZone: serif masthead centered under the top rule reading 「{callout_2}」; vertical label stack at left reading 「{selling_point_2}」; short label under the macro strip reading 「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 把秋冬外套最容易被拒绝的问题——上身显厚重、肩线撑不开——做成一眼可读的视觉对照。
shots.textZone: one short label above each half, left reading 「{callout_4}」 and right reading 「{selling_point_3}」

shots.intent: 用真实街头的侧面行走瞬间让人代入穿着场景，并交代坎肩的侧面垂坠与开襟走势。
shots.textZone: one short vertical label along the empty wall side reading 「{selling_point_4}」

shots.intent: 用微距证明做工与质感：两种质面的交界处缝合干净、毛面蓬松不倒伏。
shots.textZone: one caption label at the lower edge reading 「{callout_5}」

shots.intent: 把最容易暴露成本的边缘部位——袖口、门襟、滚边——单独放大，消除质量疑虑。
shots.textZone: two stacked labels at the right reading 「{callout_6}」 and 「{selling_point_5}」

shots.intent: 一次交代正面、侧面、背面三个面的廓形与落点，替买家回答上身到底是什么样。
shots.textZone: masthead above the triptych reading 「{callout_7}」; one 12pt label under each panel naming front, side and back

shots.intent: 让买家在同一版式里比色比质面，直接完成选款决策。
shots.textZone: masthead reading 「{callout_8}」; one small label under each color chip rendered from the colorway names supplied in the product data

shots.intent: 用平铺尺寸与四轴指数消解尺码疑虑，减少售前咨询与退换。
shots.textZone: masthead reading 「{callout_9}」; four horizontal index scales labeled 「厚薄」「版型」「衣长」「弹力」 with five tick words and one solid triangular marker each; a five-column size grid whose header and every cell value come from the supplied product data rather than being invented

shots.intent: 以平铺全貌与做工印记收口全页，把决策落点放在可见的工艺本身而非任何资质口号。
shots.textZone: masthead reading 「{callout_10}」; three badge captions and one closing line reading 「{selling_point_6}」 placed in the clear lower band

style.backgroundSystem: two backgrounds only, alternating: a weathered painted concrete mural wall with large abstract color fields #2E6A86 and #B4693A rendered out of focus, and a flat #F7F5F2 editorial print panel carrying drop-shadowed photo cards; never a third background language
style.direction: high-contrast editorial fashion magazine system for a womens outerwear detail page
style.iconSystem: flat solid circular seal badges in #9E2A30 holding one short Chinese word, plus thin double zig-zag rules beneath mastheads; no 3D icons, no line illustration, no emoji
style.lightingSystem: low-key directional soft key from camera left at 4500K with negative fill on the shadow side and a texture-reading rim light on all mural shots; even high-key 5500K with near-flat shadow on the #F7F5F2 infographic panels; the key direction never flips inside a single shot
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: high-contrast editorial fashion magazine system for a womens outerwear detail page; fixed palette of #F7F5F2 print panel, #2D2D2D text, #5A5F63 neutral mid-tone and one #9E2A30 crimson accent; cool color temperature throughout; two type tiers only, a high-contrast serif masthead and one geometric sans-serif for labels, never a third font; backgrounds alternate strictly between a weathered painted concrete mural wall with large abstract color fields #2E6A86 and #B4693A shot out of focus and a flat #F7F5F2 editorial print panel with drop-shadowed photo cards; lighting is a low-key directional soft key from camera left at 4500K with negative fill and a texture-reading rim light, switching to even high-key 5500K on the print panels, and the key direction never flips within a shot; graphic devices are limited to flat circular seal badges in #9E2A30 and thin double zig-zag rules under mastheads; garment worn open-front with stable scale, consistent crop and real contact shadows; no palette changes, no third font, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no new badge styles, no QR codes, no store badges, no invented specs.
noDrift: no new badge or icon styles
no QR codes, store badges or member entry points
no invented measurements, materials or certifications
style.presentationRules: outerwear always worn open-front with relaxed or crossed arms; stable garment scale and a consistent head-to-hem crop across look shots; the reference garments two contrasting surface textures must stay readable; hanger and flat-lay shots share one angle family
style.surfaceSystem: painted exterior concrete for worn shots, matte #F7F5F2 paper field for layout pages; every hanging or flat-lay garment keeps a real contact shadow, nothing floats
style.typography: two tiers only: a high-contrast serif masthead for section titles and one geometric sans-serif for labels and numerals, copy in #2D2D2D, masthead 32-48pt, labels 10-14pt, all Chinese text wrapped in 「」
